reviewed_findings.claim: Within each peptide length: label==1 positives and label==0 negatives; q=ceil(group/maxbat), p=ceil(P/q), n=int(min(ceil(N/q),p/(1-.99)-p)); emit slices while positives remain. Positives each referenced once, negatives at most once; excess negatives or all-negative length groups can be omitted. No replacement. Empty overall emitted list fails on first-batch indexing. The requested maxbat can be exceeded by class-wise rounding.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Static source path at pinned commit; no external execution or historical run verification.

reviewed_findings.claim: BCEWithLogitsLoss, AdamW with args.lr; EL optimizer receives all model parameters. Defaults: lr=5e-5, epochs=50, maxbat=32; other AdamW settings come from dependency defaults. CLI supplies no validation-set or early-stopping procedure; each requested epoch is saved.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Static source path at pinned commit; no external execution or historical run verification.

reviewed_findings.claim: Pandas positional-column CSV input, skip header count (CLI default 1), peptide strings uppercased, original MHC string retained; uid uses punctuation-stripped uppercase MHC plus peptide. Targets cast float32; lengths int8; no explicit finite/binary or length-range validation. EL grouping selects only exact 0/1; IM passes float targets into BCE.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Static source path at pinned commit; no external execution or historical run verification.

reviewed_findings.claim: No models argument creates a default BigMHC. Providing any model when training activates transfer mode before model aliases are expanded; custom path can select one model. Training refuses multiple models, so the seven-model el/im alias cannot directly train an ensemble.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Static source path at pinned commit; no external execution or historical run verification.

reviewed_findings.claim: CLI hardcodes seed=1 for Python, NumPy, Torch and CUDA and sets cuDNN deterministic flags. Dataframe and DataLoader shuffle are separate. Batches are rebuilt each epoch. DataLoader uses persistent workers; source does not explicitly synchronize subsequent parent Dataset.df/bats mutations into worker copies.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Static settings verified; exact worker-visible rows across epochs and cross-version/GPU determinism remain unresolved.

reviewed_findings.claim: Transfer optimizer selects exactly condenser.att.weight, condenser.att.bias, condenser.out.weight, condenser.out.bias: four tensors in two Linear modules of the same BigMHC architecture. Other weights are outside the optimizer, but source does not set their requires_grad=False or put the encoder into eval mode; whole model train() leaves dropout active.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Static source path at pinned commit; no external execution or historical run verification.

reviewed_findings.claim: Per-epoch transfer batching uses negfrac=None with default evendist=False, grouped by peptide length and sliced at maxbat. The initial loader uses evendist=True for transfer, but train() rebuilds it. Transfer batches with target sum zero are skipped before forward/loss/step; for valid binary labels these are all-negative batches. Remaining mixed batches retain their negatives.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Does not establish which rows or skip counts were used in the published experiments; missing/invalid labels are not validated upstream.

reviewed_findings.claim: EL save writes all state_dict tensors; transfer save writes only the four selected tensors, into out/epN. Loading exactly four .lyr files triggers parent-directory base lookup and filename substitution, then constructs default BigMHC and loads combined state. A transfer subdirectory alone is incomplete. No dataset hashes, parent-content hashes, optimizer state, RNG state or explicit lineage manifest are written by this path.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Parent lookup is established code behavior, not verified published weight ancestry; custom output layouts need explicit base preservation.

reviewed_findings.claim: EL alias names seven models/bat{2**x}, x=9..15; IM selects each /im child. Inference uses eval and no_grad, averages sigmoid probabilities across models (not sigmoid of averaged logits), averages attention, and writes original input MHC strings rather than resolved encoder identities. Only el/im short aliases are expanded by _parseModel; README long aliases are not branches in this pinned implementation.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Static source path at pinned commit; no external execution or historical run verification.

reviewed_findings.claim: mhcuid uppercases and removes nonalphanumerics, without biological allele validation. Encoder __getitem__ uses nearestMHC: exact sanitized key, substitution cache, optional HLA prefix for one-letter-plus-numbers, progressively shortened prefix, then Levenshtein nearest key with first-encounter tie handling. Unsupported strings may map to a known allele; empty strings can index-error. Contains checks exact sanitized membership, unlike getitem. Many-to-one mappings possible.
reviewed_findings.limitations: Static source path at pinned commit; no external execution or historical run verification.

runtime_uncertainties.finding: Persistent worker Dataset copies may retain first-epoch batch/dataframe state while main-process makebats mutates parent state. Code has no explicit synchronization. Actual consumption across epochs cannot be certified statically.
runtime_uncertainties.support: Pinned cli.py _loadData and train.py train; https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/data.html (multi-process loading and persistent_workers). Current docs support the concern; historical 1.13 docs/runtime were not verified.

runtime_uncertainties.finding: Loss normalization divides accumulated non-skipped errors by len(data), including skipped IM batches; printed epoch loss is not automatically a row-weighted or updated-batch mean.
